extracted.intended_audience: researchers and methodologists conducting systematic reviews of outcome measurement instruments, rheumatology clinicians interested in measurement properties, and psychometricians
extracted.subtask_description: A registered protocol for a systematic review that will summarize evidence on psychometric measurement properties of ACR-recommended rheumatoid arthritis disease activity instruments, conducted and reported according to PRISMA-COSMIN guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope: ACR-recommended disease activity measures
rubrics_metrics.description: The review will summarize evidence on key psychometric traits in ACR-recommended disease activity measures: DAS28-ESR, DAS28-CRP, and SDAI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These three instruments are the explicit focus of the review; the attached protocol (not fully shown on this page) contains the full inclusion/exclusion criteria and procedural details for assessing these instruments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal construct validity
rubrics_metrics.description: Evidence for internal construct validity will be summarized, explicitly including analyses such as principal component analysis (PCA), exploratory factor analysis (EFA), and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page names PCA, EFA, and CFA as the analytic approaches whose evidence will be evaluated; the protocol likely specifies how studies using these methods will be judged and synthesized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal consistency
rubrics_metrics.description: The review will summarize evidence for internal consistency, noted on the page as 'CA' (presumably Cronbach's alpha).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details such as thresholds, interpretation, or alternative internal consistency metrics (e.g., omega) are not shown on this page and should be consulted in the full protocol.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimal Clinically Important Difference (MCID)
rubrics_metrics.description: The review aims to summarize evidence for the MCID for the disease activity measures under study.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states MCID as an outcome of interest; methodological details on how MCID estimates will be identified, extracted, or compared are in the full protocol.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of PRISMA-COSMIN guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: The systematic review will be conducted and reported in accordance with PRISMA-COSMIN guidelines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adherence to PRISMA-COSMIN implies use of COSMIN methodology for assessing measurement properties and PRISMA standards for reporting systematic reviews; the page refers readers to the attached protocol for full methodological detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population: patients with a rheumatoid arthritis diagnosis
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessments and evidence synthesis are focused on patients diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page specifies the target population as RA patients; specific diagnostic criteria or eligibility definitions (e.g., ACR/EULAR criteria) are not detailed here and presumably appear in the full protocol.
